policy: Only normalized records with explicit retention permission persist; only llm_allowed facts enter synthesis. Public government factual extracts are admitted with the source acknowledgement required by their terms. No account or credential discovery. Continuity carries structured prior state (watches, relationships, snapshots) for at most one exchange session between close and premarket; retention of run archives is thirty days in Actions artifacts.
